title: NEXORA ConnectorProfile
description: A user-selectable profile backed by the Connector: an ordered set of Servers plus the policy that picks among them. It compiles to a single chrome.proxy FixedProfile pointing at a loopback inbound (ADR-0013), which is what keeps existing Omega SwitchProfile rules referencing it working across cut-over.

id.description: UUID v4 assigned by the extension at creation. It is the storage-key suffix (-nexora.profile.<id>) and the value the Connector echoes back, so it must never be regenerated on edit or survive a sync merge twice.

displayName.description: Label shown in the UI. Not the Omega profile name: the bridge writes '+<displayName>' into the envelope only if that name is free (docs/architecture/24).

kind.description: Discriminator, so that a future entity sharing the key namespace cannot be mistaken for a profile the legacy engine must iterate.

serverIds.description: Order is meaningful: it is the failover ranking and the 'fastest' tie-break.

defaultServerId.description: Membership in serverIds is checked by scripts/verify.mjs -- JSON Schema cannot compare two instance fields.

selection.description: How the active Server is chosen among serverIds. Decides transport behaviour, not request routing -- that is routingPolicyId and the browser plane.

mode.description: fixed = defaultServerId only; ordered = walk serverIds on failure; fastest = rank by rolling health probes; roundRobin = spread.

stickySeconds.description: How long 'fastest' keeps a ranking before re-ranking. Without it, a single slow probe would flip the active server mid-session.

failover.description: When a Server stops working, what the profile does about it. Owns cooldown and eviction so one dead server cannot be re-picked on every request.

failurePolicy.description: Per-profile override of the global fail-closed default (ADR-0009).

routingPolicyId.description: Optional reference to a routing-policy document (browser-plane rules stay on the Omega profile; core-plane rules compile into Xray routing).

enabled.description: Disabled profiles keep their id and server links but compile to nothing and are hidden from the switcher. Distinct from deleting, which would break references.

createdAt.description: Set once at creation by the extension and never rewritten, so that 'added in this import' is answerable.

updatedAt.description: Last user-visible mutation. The Connector MUST NOT use it to decide anything; it exists for the UI and for sync conflict reporting.
